items.title: Lease ends (ordentliche Kündigung effective date)
items.quote: hiermit kündige ich das Mietverhältnis über die Wohnung Ruhrallee 77, 2. Obergeschoss rechts, ordentlich zum 28.02.2027.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date on which the tenancy ends ('ordentlich zum 28.02.2027'). A printed calendar date is used as written and is not subject to weekend/holiday shifting rules (notice/termination dates are not moved).

items.title: Deadline for tenant's objection (Widerspruch) to the termination under §§ 574-574b BGB
items.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens am 31.12.2026 zugehen.
items.computation: The landlord explicitly states the calendar date by which any objection (social hardship clause, §§ 574-574b BGB) must reach her in text form: 31.12.2026. This is a fixed date set by the sender, not a statutory period to be counted from delivery, so it is used exactly as written; 31 Dec 2026 is a Thursday and not a public holiday, so no shift is needed.

warnings: The letter was hand-delivered by a messenger on 19.11.2026 at ~10:00, which the sender should be able to prove (e.g. messenger's written confirmation) if the tenant disputes the delivery date.

If the tenant believes moving out would be an undue hardship, any objection under §§ 574-574b BGB must be in text form and reach the landlord by 31.12.2026 at the latest; missing this deadline may forfeit the right to object.
